name: Whip Tilt
description: The camera tilts fast from the first clip to the second, set edge to edge at an angle above it, streaking both in perspective with a vertical motion blur. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: down
params.description: Tilt the camera down to a second clip below instead of above

params.name: blur
params.description: Length of the motion blur along the tilt

params.name: chroma
params.description: How much the color channels split apart as the tilt speeds up

params.name: perspective
params.description: Strength of the perspective (field of view of the camera)
